units.source_text: 但此乃十分艰巨之事业。”

en.t: But this is an exceedingly difficult undertaking.

units.source_text: 三公主正在挥泪读信，源氏进来了。

en.t: The Third Princess was reading the letter through her tears when Genji came in.

units.source_text: 他看见室中和往常不同，公主身边放着些果盘，觉得很奇怪，

en.t: He noticed that the room looked different from usual, with some trays of fruit set beside the Princess, and found it very strange,

units.source_text: 一看，原来是朱雀院来信。

en.t: and when he looked, he saw that it was a letter from the Suzaku Retired Emperor.

units.source_text: 他拿过信来一读，觉得非常感动。

en.t: He took up the letter and read it, and was deeply moved.

units.source_text: 信很详细，内有句云：“我似觉命终之日，即在目前。

en.t: The letter was detailed, and in it were the words, "I feel as though the day of my death is already close at hand.

units.source_text: 常思与你会面，深恐不能如愿。”

en.t: I constantly long to see you, but greatly fear that my wish may not be fulfilled."

units.source_text: 诗中诱导三公主一同往生净土，此乃僧人常谈，并无何等意趣，

en.t: In the poem he invited the Third Princess to be reborn with him in the Pure Land; this was merely the usual talk of monks and held no special charm,

units.source_text: 但他想道：“朱雀院当然作如是想。

en.t: but Genji thought, "It is only natural that the Suzaku Retired Emperor should think this way.

units.source_text: 他看见连我这个寄托终身的人态度也很冷淡，

en.t: He sees that even I, the one to whom her whole life was entrusted, treat her with great coldness,

units.source_text: 就越发替三公主担心了，真可怜啊！”

en.t: and so he must worry all the more for the Third Princess. How pitiful she is!"

units.source_text: 三公主仔细地写回信，叫人拿一套深宝蓝色的绫罗衣服赏赐了使者。

en.t: The Third Princess carefully wrote a reply and had a set of deep sapphire-blue silk robes given to the messenger.

units.source_text: 源氏看见帷屏边露出三公主写坏了的信纸，

en.t: Genji saw a spoiled sheet of the Third Princess's writing peeking out beside the curtain screen,

units.source_text: 便拿起来看，但见笔迹非常稚嫩。

en.t: so he picked it up and looked at it, only to find that the handwriting was extremely childish.
